grid.formula: x_j = L * (j/N + alpha/(2*pi) * sin(2*pi*j/N)), j = 0, ..., N-1

required_keys.spectral_radius: max |lambda_i| over all eigenvalues of spatial operator L
required_keys.dt_max_forward_euler: maximum stable dt for Forward Euler time integration
required_keys.dt_max_rk4: maximum stable dt for Classical RK4 time integration
required_keys.rk4_simulation_l2_error: RMS error sqrt(mean((u_num - u_exact)^2)) at final time
required_keys.eigenvalues_real: real parts of all N eigenvalues of L, sorted by magnitude ascending
required_keys.eigenvalues_imag: imaginary parts of all N eigenvalues of L, sorted by magnitude ascending
required_keys.fd_weights_d1_at_j32: 5-element array: 1st derivative FD weights at grid point j=32
required_keys.fd_weights_d2_at_j32: 5-element array: 2nd derivative FD weights at grid point j=32
